description: Brea Mall is a premier enclosed shopping destination in Orange County featuring major department stores and a diverse mix of popular retailers. Managed by Simon Property Group, this regional mall offers extensive shopping, dining, and entertainment options for the surrounding community. Conveniently located in Brea, California, the mall serves as a central retail hub for residents throughout North Orange County.
demographics: Brea Mall attracts a diverse, family-oriented demographic with middle to upper-middle income households, including young professionals and families with children from surrounding Orange County communities. The trade area draws heavily from affluent neighborhoods in Brea, Fullerton, Placentia, and Yorba Linda, with visitors typically in the 25-54 age range and household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. Shoppers favor a mix of fashion-forward national retailers, value-oriented brands, and dining options, with strong weekend traffic driven by family entertainment and leisure shopping patterns.
